items.title: Qualcomm forecasts weak quarterly profit, expects Apple revenue drop to accelerate
items.summary: Qualcomm forecast fourth-quarter profit below Wall Street estimates on Wednesday, and said revenue from Apple products would decline faster than expected as supply constraints and rising costs weighed on ‌its business.  In an interview ‌with Reuters, CEO Cristiano Amon said costs had risen not just for memory chips, but across the supply chain.  Qualcomm plans to raise prices ​starting September 1 in an effort to return its margins to historical levels, he said.

items.summary: Apple stock has had a strong five year run, yet Simply Wall St's valuation checks flag it as leaning expensive, with the Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) estimate indicating the shares trade at a premium to intrinsic value while market based multiples look closer to fair. Apple has returned 136.8% over the past five years, which sets a high bar for any further gains to be justified by future cash flows. items.title: Apple says UK App Store proposal amounts to price regulation
items.summary: LONDON, July 29 (Reuters) - Apple said on Wednesday that proposed UK rules governing its App Store would amount to price regulation, arguing that plans to loosen ‌its control over in-app payments could undermine innovation and investment. In a submission to Britain's ‌Competition and Markets Authority, the iPhone maker said proposed "steering" requirements would go beyond promoting competition and give the regulator a "highly ​intrusive" role in managing its business.
